note: The reference implementations and SDKs ride these exact bytes. MANIFEST.sha256 covers the canonical draft, the CDDL wire authority, the machine-readable registries, and the full conformance corpus (all per-family vectors + the embedded runner copy). Run scripts/verify_pins.py to recompute every pinned hash and compare; any drift exits non-zero. All pinned files are stored LF (.gitattributes eol=lf) so the hashes are platform-independent.
